title: dedicated-autoscaler-priority-scheduling-burst-util-reporting-enhancement
author: Anika Shah
description: Motivation: production Dedicated fleets saw spiky tail latency and poor visibility when priority-based request classes competed for burst tokens. This PR introduces a priority-aware scheduling path, improved token-bucket smoothing parameters, and additional utilization/burst reporting metrics for fleet operators. Summary: 1) Adds a priority scheduler that factors in guaranteed throughput contracts and burst eligibility to reduce starvation of lower-priority guaranteed customers while preserving burst headroom for high-priority requests. 2) Implements tokenbucket smoothing with configurable lookback and decay to avoid sudden drain during short bursts. 3) Exposes per-fleet and per-priority utilization metrics (burst_tokens_used, burst_tokens_reserved, smoothed_throughput, queued_requests_by_priority) and a new FleetUtilization API endpoint used by Redwood Console to populate per-route dashboards. 4) Integrates reporting into existing autoscaler telemetry so historical burst events can be correlated with scale-up/down decisions. Checklist: - [x] design doc and Linear ticket linked - [x] unit + integration tests - [x] dashboard and alert prototype - [x] docs and changelog entry - [x] staged rollout with canary. Backwards compatibility: default behavior unchanged unless priority scheduler is enabled via config; all new metrics are additive. Rollout plan: enable in canary region, monitor smoothed_throughput and 99p latency, adjust smoothing params by fleet. Related: Linear ENG-1248, ENG-2134.
